name: @hobo/provider-prisma-postgres
description: HoBo Prisma Postgres claimable provider: the data-only prisma.claimable-postgres/v1 product definition (data.postgres/v1 native), a pinned create-db CLI driver behind an injected ProcessRunner with strict JSON-mode parsing and a narrow fail-closed human-output fallback, the typed associated-resource reference a bundled (Vercel) claim strategy needs, and pg_dump/pg_restore migration.
